destination.name: Yarra Valley
destination.tagline: Cool-climate wine country an hour from Melbourne, with wildlife and a rail trail.
destination.description: The Yarra Valley is a wine region about an hour's drive from Melbourne, with more than 80 wineries known for cool-climate Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and sparkling wine. The first vineyards were planted in the 1830s, making it one of Australia's oldest wine industries. Beyond the cellar doors are a wildlife sanctuary with breeding programmes for endangered species, and TarraWarra Museum of Art, with its views over the vines.
whyVisit: Taste cool-climate wines at cellar doors

goodToKnow.title: Public transport is patchy
goodToKnow.detail: Train to Lilydale, then bus 685 to Yarra Glen, TarraWarra and Healesville. For several cellar doors, book a driver or tour.

goodToKnow.title: Check weekend-only railway
goodToKnow.detail: Yarra Valley Railway at Healesville runs only on weekends and public holidays, and Yarra Glen's market is on Sundays.

goodToKnow.title: Take the train, then cycle
goodToKnow.detail: Catch the train to Lilydale and ride the 40 km rail trail to Warburton for a car-free day in the valley.
